changenote:
[h1]Pal Insight: Quick Stack 0.1.0-beta.1[/h1]

[list]
[*]Press F5 inside the current base to store matching backpack items in compatible private storage.
[*]Respects Inventory Tab > R exclusions and never selects Guild Chests automatically.
[*]Native-style progress and result cards support all 17 Palworld interface languages.
[*]Standalone client-side mod. Pal Insight is optional; with Pal Insight 1.8.0+, the shortcut can also be changed from F6 > Controls.
[*]Single-player tested. Multiplayer and dedicated-server client behavior remain unverified during Beta.
[/list]
